name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly on Sunday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3.5.2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Lint and test
        run: npm run lint && npm run test

  kind-integration-test:
    needs: lint-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3.5.2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Set up Kind
        uses: helm/kind-action@v1.10.0
        with:
          version: '0.11.1'
      - name: Deploy Helm chart
        run: |
          helm upgrade --install falkordb-browser ./helm/falkordb-browser \
            --set replicaCount=2 \
            --set service.sessionAffinity=ClientIP \
            --set service.sessionAffinityConfig.clientIP.timeoutSeconds=180

  package-and-publish:
    needs: kind-integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3.5.2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Secure yq installation
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.40.5/yq_linux_amd64 -O /usr/local/bin/yq
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
          echo "yq $(sha256sum /usr/local/bin/yq | awk '{print $1}')" > /tmp/yq.sha256
          if ! sha256sum -c /tmp/yq.sha256; then
            echo "yq installation failed"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Package Helm chart
        run: helm package ./helm/falkordb-browser -d charts/
      - name: Check out FalkorDB/helm-charts repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          token: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN }}
      - name: Update Helm repository index
        run: helm repo index charts/
      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add charts/ index.yaml
          git commit -m "chore(helm): update chart version and index"
          git push origin main
        retries: 3
        retry-delay-minutes: 5
      - name: Serve charts via GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3.9.3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./charts
